raised.claim: orphanTriage assumes all quiet verdicts other than not_on_untappd are wontfix, falsely reporting degraded matcher_bug verdicts as wontfix in outcome metrics and digest lines.
raised.why_it_breaks: When Guard 3 degrades an unprobed not_on_untappd verdict, planTriageActions pushes it into plan.quiet with review_class: 'matcher_bug'. When orphanTriage processes plan.quiet, any verdict where review_class !== 'not_on_untappd' falls into the else branch and increments outcome.wontfix. As a result, buildTriageLine and the daily digest report these degraded matcher_bug rows as 'wontfix' even though they were triaged as matcher_bug and remain in the enrichment retry pool.

raised.claim: The saturation guard does not track rows attached earlier in the current batch, allowing a single triage run to overshoot MAX_ROWS_PER_ISSUE.
raised.why_it_breaks: If an open issue currently has postCreationRows: 11 (under MAX_ROWS_PER_ISSUE = 12) and the model assigns 5 verdicts to it in the same batch, all 5 verdicts pass the guard because target.postCreationRows is never incremented or augmented by newly attached verdicts in byIssue, resulting in 16 post-creation rows on the issue.
